title: Pals Rewards Points Multiplier on Tailwise Autoship Shipments
content:
Tailwise Autoship shipments earn Pals Rewards points at a multiple of the member's base earn rate, and the multiple is set by program.

| Program | Multiplier applied to the Pals Rewards base earn rate |
|---|---|
| Autoship Everyday | 2 |
| Autoship Litter & Bulk | 2 |
| Autoship Fresh & Frozen | 2 |
| Autoship Custom Meal Plan | 1 |
| Autoship Pharmacy | 1 |
| Autoship Compounded Pharmacy | 1 |

The multiplier is applied to the member's Pals Rewards base earn rate. A multiplier of 1 earns at the base rate; 2 earns at twice the base rate.

**Hypothetical illustration.** For a member whose base earn rate is taken, for illustration only, as 1 point per dollar, a qualifying amount of 50.00 USD would earn 100 points on Autoship Everyday (multiplier 2) and 50 points on Autoship Pharmacy (multiplier 1).
